experiences.name: Tsukiji Outer Market Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore the bustling Tsukiji Outer Market, sampling fresh sushi, tamagoyaki, and street snacks from local vendors. This is a must for food lovers wanting authentic Tokyo flavors. Since your flight arrives late on Day 1, plan this for Day 2 morning to kick off your culinary adventure properly rested.

experiences.name: Akihabara Electric Town Tech & Anime Immersion
experiences.description: Dive into Tokyo's legendary tech and otaku culture in Akihabara. Browse multi-story electronics shops, retro game arcades, maid cafes, and cutting-edge gadget stores. A paradise for tech enthusiasts. Best visited in the afternoon when all shops are fully open and the neon lights begin to glow.

experiences.name: teamLab Borderless Digital Art Museum
experiences.description: Experience one of the world's most immersive digital art installations where technology and culture merge seamlessly. Rooms filled with interactive, flowing digital art create a surreal and unforgettable experience. Book tickets in advance. Since Day 1 is largely lost to a late arrival, prioritize this as a highlight mid-trip.

experiences.name: Senso-ji Temple & Asakusa Cultural Walk
experiences.description: Visit Tokyo's oldest and most iconic Buddhist temple, Senso-ji, in the historic Asakusa district. Stroll through Nakamise shopping street for traditional crafts and snacks, and soak in centuries of Japanese culture. Morning visits offer a serene atmosphere before tourist crowds arrive. A perfect full cultural day given your 13-day duration.

experiences.name: Ramen Alley & Izakaya Hopping in Shinjuku
experiences.description: Spend an evening exploring Shinjuku's legendary Omoide Yokocho (Memory Lane) and nearby izakayas, tasting regional ramen styles, yakitori skewers, and craft sake. This is quintessential Tokyo nightlife and local food culture. Since Day 1 arrives late (20:00+), this experience is actually perfect for your arrival night — a low-effort, high-reward way to begin your trip without wasting the evening.
